title: Open Quantum Evidence Atlas
description: An executable, publication-centred audit of EU–Japan quantum research observability in the OpenAIRE Graph. The release combines a deterministic 645-record census, an Alien/OpenAIRE MCP interactive verification layer, a no-login Evidence Chain Auditor, a timestamped Q-NEKO monitoring case, and reproducibility code, notebook, data and FAIR manifests.
